thread:
Sam (sales-eng): Kicking off POC with FinixCorp tomorrow. They want least-privilege access for a small pilot: hosted keys for initial tests, then a Dedicated pool if perf looks good. Need SSO + ephemeral service account for our demo runner. Any gotchas?
Alex (infra): For hosted API keys we can create scoped API keys tied to a workspace and optionally to a project. For the demo runner we recommend an ephemeral service account token with 1h TTL.
Priya (security): Confirming: FinixCorp will send a short security questionnaire. They require SAML SSO + SCIM group sync and want separation between billing and inference admin. We'll want to map SAML groups to roles.
Mateo (acct exec): Quick pricing ask from them: estimated 50k tok/day for 2 weeks spike. Will a short Dedicated trial make sense or should we stick to hosted and watch burst limits?
Jordan (solutions): If they expect sustained throughput > ~150 rps with 2k tokens reqs, Dedicated pool trial is better. We can spin a small reserved pool (2 GPUs) as a time-limited trial under a short commit. Otherwise hosted with burst is okay but cost could be higher.
Alex (infra): On the RBAC side, roles we usually grant for POC: `workspace-admin` (only for main contact), `billing-view`, `svc-inference` (can create ephemeral keys + read models), and `reader`. Avoid giving `workspace-admin` broadly.
Priya (security): Agree. Also recommend disabling legacy static keys for the workspace and enforcing ephemeral tokens via an allowlist IP if they want extra control. We'll provide a short least-privilege checklist.
Sam (sales-eng): Can someone paste the minimal invite JSON we can send them (they want automation)?
Alex (infra): Paste below. This is what SCIM/Invite payload looks like for our onboarding script:
```json
{
  "email": "devops@finixcorp.com",
  "display_name": "Finix POC - DevOps",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "poc-engineers",
  "expires_at": "2026-06-15T23:59:59Z"
}
```
Sam (sales-eng): Nice. For SSO: do we support group-to-role mapping out of box?
Priya (security): Yes — we map SAML attributes (groups) to RBAC roles. We'll send recommended claim mapping: `groups` -> `scim_group` -> roles. Also note we require an assertion consumer URL and certificate thumbprint.
Mateo (acct exec): On the billing side, they asked whether the Dedicated short trial uses metered pricing or partial commit.
Jordan (solutions): Trials use a time-bound reserved pool with prorated commit. For a 2-week pilot we can do a discounted short commit (email finance) or let them use hosted and buy credits. I'll loop in pricing.
Sam (sales-eng): Can we give them ephemeral key creation CLI example?
Alex (infra): Yep. Example CLI curl to mint ephemeral token for svc-inference role (1h TTL):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/finixcorp/ephemeral_tokens" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
sre-bot: Deployment link: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/finixcorp/onboard (expires in 7 days) :link:
Priya (security): Notes to include in questionnaire reply: KMS integration (customer-managed key) for Private mode, SOC2/ISO links, SCIM docs, and our network control options (VPC peering, allowed IPs). If they will send PHI/PII we must recommend Private deployment and KMS.
Mateo (acct exec): FinixCorp is okay to start with test data but may bring sample PII later. Let's advise Private option early.
Sam (sales-eng): Action items: (1) Alex — prepare invite/SCIM payload and ephemeral token example (2) Jordan — pricing note + short commit option (3) Priya — draft security questionnaire response + recommend mapping (4) Mateo — schedule intro call with FinixCorp devops for tomorrow 11am PT.
Alex (infra): Working on the payload now, will paste minimal IAM mapping shortly.
Jordan (solutions): I'll email pricing within 2 hours.
Priya (security): Drafting the questionnaire reply, will include required SAML attributes we need.
Mateo (acct exec): Scheduled the call and cc'd Finix contact.
Sam (sales-eng): Thanks all. If we need a Dedicated pool toggle for the demo I can request one-off capacity from infra.
Alex (infra): FYI for infra: for Dedicated we need: GPU type, expected RPS, token size distribution, and commit length. If they want quantized models or lower-cost tiers we can recommend a 3-day burst followed by commit.
Sam (sales-eng): Great — closing the loop here, will post any followups in this thread. :thumbsup:
